user.title: Twinkly Area Manager
user.description: Use devices already configured by Home Assistant's Twinkly integration (automatically prefilled where available), or enter controller names and private LAN IPs as JSON. Capture and verification are read-only; cloud group changes are performed by the separate guarded CLI.

native.title: Choose Twinkly controllers
native.description: Choose which physical Twinkly controllers this Area Manager should monitor. These come from the built-in Twinkly integration; no additional network scan is performed.

manual.title: Enter Twinkly controller IP addresses
manual.description: Enter a JSON array of controller names and private LAN IPv4 addresses. Use Home Assistant's native Twinkly integration first if automatic discovery is available.

error.invalid_devices: Provide a nonempty JSON array with unique names and private IPv4 addresses.

cloud.title: Twinkly cloud login (optional)
cloud.description: Sign in once to enable cloud operations. The password is not retained; access and refresh tokens are stored privately in Home Assistant. Select forget to remove the saved session.

controllers.title: Manage controllers
controllers.description: Edit the full controller list or paste your complete devices.json. Existing maps are retained. Confirm removal if deleting or changing an address. Saving reloads the integration.

data.confirm_removal: Confirm removal or IP address changes

error.cloud_auth_failed: Cloud login failed. Check your credentials and network connection.
error.invalid_devices: Enter a nonempty JSON list with unique names and private IPv4 addresses.
error.confirm_removal: Confirm removal or address changes before saving.
